item.title: Synology DSM Auth API Pre-Auth SQL Injection via Escape Truncation (CVE-2026-76954)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-76954 / Synology-SA-26:19. Status: PoC (lab-only differential). Affects: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Auth API — libsyno-pam-login.so.7.0 (SynoPamKeyImpl::DBEscapeStrings), writing to syno-pam-key.db through libsynodb.so. Tags: SQLi, CWE-89, Synology DSM, Auth API, pre-auth, unauthenticated, escape-truncation, stacked-SQL, sqlite, PAM.
